summary.text: Immemorial desolate beasts are overlords recorded since the immemorial era. The text gives them rank eight Gu Immortal battle strength, with further tiers among that rank.

claims.text: While refining earth treasury flower Gu, Fang Yuan uses eight desolate blood powder: blood of eight kinds of immemorial desolate beasts, mixed, solidified, and ground into powder.

Above desolate beasts sit ancient desolate beasts and immemorial desolate beasts. Immemorial desolate beasts are recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu; one example named there is the nine-tailed fox. Fang Yuan, considering what Hu Immortal blessed land could raise, calls a nine-tailed fox there no more than a dream.
Lower tiers on the same ladder are covered on desolate beast and ancient desolate beast.

Inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Fang Yuan sees Reckless Savage Demon Venerable facing the immemorial desolate beast Primordial Ash Owl. The text calls immemorial desolate beasts overlords that have existed within heaven and earth since the immemorial era, with rank eight Gu Immortal battle strength. Reckless Savage later eats that rank eight desolate beast as casually as an insufficient meal.

Southern Border’s Mount Snail is an immemorial desolate beast, an enormous river snail with a tall, tower-like spiral shell wrapped in green moss that reads as a mountain while its body stays hidden inside. Its body carries both enslavement path and earth path dao marks, and they surround it with an environment that spawns resources of both paths. Few Gu Immortals can control it, and it is very difficult even for rank eight enslavement path Gu Immortals, because the snail itself is full of enslavement path dao marks.

Rank eight battle strength does not make immemorial desolate beasts equal: narration sorts them into tiers within that rank. The myriad head coiling dragon is one of the weaker immemorial desolate beasts. Looking at the ravaged battlefield, Xue Er thinks that ordinary beasts of this tier cannot handle a Gu Immortal at rank eight battle strength, since human intelligence and wisdom bring countless immortal killer moves.
Year beasts that use the same desolate-to-immemorial strength ladder are covered on year beast.
